name: Preparation
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of wise and diligent preparation as a reflection of prudence and faithfulness. Proverbs encourages believers to learn from the ant's industriousness and to prudently foresee and avoid evil by preparing their work carefully before building their house. In the New Testament, Jesus calls His followers to spiritual readiness, urging them to watch and be prepared for His unexpected return, highlighting that endurance and vigilance are essential for salvation.
